summary: Tests for what an instance uninstall removes, and the guarded-folder check for the work folder now also follows links, so a work root that reaches Documents, Desktop or Downloads through a link is refused.

replay.detail: No claim replay, projection rebuild or store recovery changes.

schema.detail: No database tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema transitions.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or coordinated fleet-upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: A work_root that was accepted only because it reached a guarded folder through a link is now refused at startup with the existing error; every other config is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No daemon lifecycle changes or additional service restart requirement.

manual.detail: No manual step or persisted-state migration.

recovery.detail: Point work_root at a folder that is not inside Documents, Desktop or Downloads.
